This is a **list of the longest rivers on Earth**. It includes [river systems](River_systems "River systems") over 1,000 kilometres (620 mi) in length.

## Definition of length

There are many factors, such as the identification of the source,[[1]](List_of_river_systems_by_length#cite_note-amazon-river-source-1) the identification or the definition of the mouth, and the scale of measurement[[2]](List_of_river_systems_by_length#cite_note-2) of the river length between source and mouth, that determine the precise meaning of "river length". As a result, the length measurements of many rivers are only approximations (see also [coastline paradox](Coastline_paradox "Coastline paradox")). In particular, there seems to exist disagreement as to whether the <Nile>[[3]](List_of_river_systems_by_length#cite_note-britannica-nile-3) or the [Amazon](Amazon_River "Amazon River")[[4]](List_of_river_systems_by_length#cite_note-britannica-amazon-4) is the world's longest river.
